topPRs.title: fix(lifeops): bind email approvals and checkpoint reviewed account handoff
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
Family setup could change a Google destination without review and authorize email against stale packet content. This change binds owner approval to the exact draft and sender, adds reviewed calendar routing, and persists account-switch checkpoints so interrupted work can be resumed without repeating committed effects.

The implementation includes:

- Immutable monthly packet/draft approval bindings, authenticated owner decisions through the canonical queue, Unicode Gmail subjects, and duplicate suppression for recorded delivery outcomes.
- Explicit sender bindings for scheduling, meeting follow-up and delegation emails. Delegation replies use the receiving account from trusted runtime provenance; ambiguous or disconnected accounts fail before approval creation.
- Owner-scoped account-switch reviews, retirement inventory, pause/drain controls, versioned calendar mappings and source selections, recipient identity checks, replacement Google verification, guarded disconnection, import disposition, and pause ownership recovery. Owner-authorized HTTP checkpoints now execute the reviewed Google switch, with durable readback and cancellation before execution. Non-email destinations fail before any pause or disconnection. The onboarding UI now saves exact choices, reads active progress on reopening, and advances or cancels the saved review. Event selection includes the revision shown to the owner; changed events require a new review. Failed steps scroll their error into view.
- Approval insertion, retirement and both dispatch claim paths share a database lock and persisted control revisions. Retired approvals cannot execute after handoff; fresh explicitly bound approvals remain usable after reconnect. Unbound Google approvals require a new account review after retirement. Additive migration preserves old rows, which remain fenced for retired account scopes.
- Reviewed school-source facts in family drafts. Opted-in imports use stored school titles and dates, excluding private calendar edits. Existing sources without a sharing policy remain private.
- Correct calendar source labels and required PDF-extraction errors surfaced as unavailable with diagnostics. Failed initial connection inventory now shows an unavailable state and Retry instead of falsely claiming no account is connected or offering setup actions.

Latest published head: `97c527856f41a2287e179fcc4f14660e74c3fd77`, including develop `754bb18e1599f`. Install/root verify pass; personal-assistant package: 307 files, 2,683 passed, six existing skips. Exact-head desktop/phone browser journeys pass. [Connection error/retry, saved-review recovery, MP4s, browser logs and validation evidence](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/pr-evidence-12/connection-inventory-97c5278.zip). The full 226-check app audit ran on the same UI repair before the develop merge; all 12 OCR exceptions were inspected as declared unavailable/fallback states. Linux root verify and personal-assistant/Google/app builds pass. The isolated pilot now runs `97c5278`; [deployment receipt](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/pr-evidence-12/connection-inventory-97c5278-deployment.json) verifies 3,577 build files, served entry/view assets, three deep links, unchanged calendar pause revision14 and unchanged saved packet hash. Live browser readback reached the loading view but computer control then timed out; successful current-pilot UI rendering is not yet claimed. Hosted PostgreSQL, billing and Windows checks pass; source smoke remains pending.

**Keep this PR in draft.** Full MVP acceptance is incomplete. Remaining release work includes deploying and validating the reviewed UI with live two-account cutover, PDF extraction, knowledge pin/ACL and guest/revocation flows, useful selected-source monthly packet intake, and iMessage/Telegram/Discord acceptance. Configured connectors and deterministic test ports are not live delivery evidence.

Related: #30123, #30991, #30998, #31010, #31011, #31015, #31026, #31028, #31030, #31039. Incorporates overlapping drafts #31003 and #31006; do not merge them independently.

Current source: `6e5af7a93e01fb4edf5be7cd3a018c1c0547f386`, including merged develop `5bf3faef78a9a214431fb3e8a7eaa0f0518767de`. No conflicts. The isolated pilot now runs this exact source. Linux verification and release builds passed; served entry and onboarding bundle hashes match. A consistent pre-deployment backup was taken; paused calendar control and the existing monthly packet were preserved.

topPRs.title: fix: repair first-run activation, plugin staging, and recovery validation
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
First-run activation persists the selected model and account routing through readiness, chat and cold restart. Failed activation restores still-owned durable and live configuration without overwriting concurrent updates. Busy admission rejects before persistence. Plugin staging preserves source entries and dependency identities, relocates Windows junctions before publication, and builds runtime exports in dependency order.

Background evaluation now finishes durably before scenario fixtures yield ownership. Complete visible entity names and IDs have stable ordering, so hidden display-name metadata cannot invalidate an unchanged evaluator request. Recovery control output stays out of visible responses while complete model inputs and recordings remain intact. Selected UI controls retain their selected state and readable nested text, pipeline badges use the canonical design variant, and Accounts actions wrap within mobile cards.

The Accounts inventory route shares one freshly validated credential snapshot across provider projections, reducing a measured request from 29 full reads to 2 including the expiry sweep. It preserves existing selection policies and older host compatibility; corrupt storage still fails explicitly. The branch also repairs deterministic scenario contracts and CI prerequisite/import/timer failures without weakening their behavioral assertions.

Current head: `7321244a200285498ff831164f4918250d54407b`, rebased onto `d07f6dc2e2271ab8e4ebc2fef2cf389e40dabb39`. Normal frozen installation, the complete root verification, and all 99 combined scenarios passed with Bun 1.3.14 and Node 24.15.0. The browser fixture now advances its real workspace tab only after the real action emits a nonmatching URL poll; it no longer races a 500 ms timer. Production polling and the at-least-two-polls assertion remain unchanged.

Previous head `2ea08dc` passed PR admission and Windows runtime qualification. Its full CI first attempt failed one real Worker Twilio assertion (expected configuration HTTP 503, received HTTP 500); an explicit failed-job rerun now passes all full CI jobs. The same source passes fresh local Worker/PGlite qualification: all 18 cloud API E2E files, 517 passes, zero failures, 18 explicit skips. This does not explain or erase the hosted failure. Final selected-state UI and actual activation/restart HTTP qualification are tracked separately below.

topPRs.title: fix(calendar): require reviewed sync destinations and recover uncertain writes
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
Connecting another Google account could change the implicit destination for new built-in calendar links. This change requires an owner-reviewed writable account and calendar, with synchronization paused by default. Durable revision checks and mutation receipts reject stale reviews and prevent destination replacement while a provider outcome is unknown. Rejected remaps preserve existing event identities.

The connections view and registered personal-assistant calendar routes support destination selection, pause/resume, and pending-dispatch recovery. Recovery reads the provider before settling an uncertain receipt. Failures before any external mutation release the receipt; uncertain writes retain it and block replay.

Live school-calendar testing exposed loss of all-day semantics, rejected timed-to-all-day patches, and repeated writes caused by provider timezone normalization. Linked snapshots preserve all-day state in both directions. Google updates explicitly clear incompatible date/dateTime fields. All-day semantic comparison ignores timezone metadata and avoids provider writes when the local and remote event already agree, including older checkpoints.

The production connections view also failed to load because its shared host importer left a bare package specifier in the browser. A literal dynamic import now lets the bundler provide `@elizaos/shared`. The built frontend opens the real pilot connections view, refreshes sync status, and exposes replacement-account controls without browser errors.

Validation at `72e2be875d5707442dc87029988bb1a683e9ce9c`, incorporating fetched develop `d7df7af187f05ec744b57c01799cfbabcc5fd325`:

- Pinned install, root verification, UI typecheck and production web build passed.
- DynamicViewLoader:44 tests passed. App audit:222 capture tests passed;216 findings with zero computed broken/needs-work. OCR:203 verified,0 broken,13 requiring inspection. Family captures inspected across four viewports; phone-landscape upload-control clearance still needs live scrolling acceptance. The audit is not a blanket visual pass.
- Full UI suite:14006 passed,49 failed,7 skipped,2 unhandled errors. Controlled serial runs of the22 failing files on the original and fixed loaders produced identical results:29 failures,732 passes,2 unhandled errors, with identical failed-test names. These existing failures remain open.
- Calendar:874 passed/4 skipped at preceding7fa812, whose calendar source is unchanged here. Google:407 passed at prior75da45. Personal-assistant unit2607 passed/6 skipped and integration426 passed at prioraad00. Those suites are not claimed rerun at this head.
- Actual Google readback at7fa812 preserved all28 disposable event identities, content and ETags after resumed sync and pilot restart. All27 links were clean, with no pending dispatch. A manual reconciliation sweep hit rate limiting and is not counted as completed.

Live evidence from the isolated pilot: a built-in synthetic event reached the selected disposable Google calendar, and a Google-side edit returned to the same built-in event. The elementary school workflow imported26 events, and its repeated hash check returned unchanged. All26 Google events were repaired to date-only all-day entries with original identities and source date bounds. The canonical monthly task executed once and suppressed replay.

The deployed pilot is7fa812. The72e2be frontend repair has built locally and passed browser acceptance against the live backend; its separate VPS build and deployment remain pending.

Keep draft. The monthly packet currently duplicates linked school events and misclassifies them as custody entries; no packet email was sent. Complete account/data disposition, cross-channel approval invalidation, live unknown-outcome recovery, final installed UI walkthrough, real guest authorization, and live-model acceptance remain outstanding. This PR does not establish full MVP readiness.

Related: #30991, #31010 and #30123. Packet duplication is tracked in #31011.

Historical reviewed synthetic UI evidence at `c4ef9f27afb03` (later backend changes are not depicted):

- [destination-hover-reviewed.jpg](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/pr-evidence-4/31003-c4ef9f2-destination-hover-reviewed.jpg)

These recordings exercise deterministic adapters. Screenshots show the calendar panel/viewport, not a full-page or installed-host acceptance result. The final app captures were inspected at desktop, tablet and both phone orientations. Phone landscape requires a follow-up scroll/composer-overlap check; no blanket visual acceptance is claimed.

topPRs.title: fix(ci): repair Develop Full validation and runtime boundary failures
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
Develop Full exposed SQL size-boundary failures, stale deterministic action fixtures, and shared UI accessibility failures. This repair preserves complete declared SQL source content, validates simulated model decisions against real request/tool receipts, isolates simulated scenarios from native iMessage loading, and repairs contrast and responsive controls. Addresses #30839; native isolation is tracked in #29067. The merged workflow consolidation owns CI wiring; this PR changes no workflows.

<!-- evidence-head:a1ccc85ea8e1c725048a29aaee51458fce159c2d -->

## Changes

- Preserve complete memory and attachment source fields above 1 MiB while retaining metadata, structure, accessor, depth/node and NUL safeguards. Preserve the existing 32 MiB document-fragment budget on create/update, including stored-row type enforcement.
- Correlate deterministic evaluator responses with the original request, action arguments and actual tool receipt. Keep durable TODO persistence, privilege denials and strict grounding assertions. OpenAI transport tests check the complete native schema or fallback prompt contract without dropping original turn context.
- Disable native iMessage before lazy loading in simulated scenarios while preserving explicitly registered synthetic services. Require observed browser content separately from navigation completion.
- Repair shared UI contrast, orange hover states, billing layout, account counts and mobile social-card wrapping. Require the actual Relationships view root in its route probe, incorporating #31564.

## Validation and revision scope

Final candidate `a1ccc85ea8e1c725048a29aaee51458fce159c2d` is based on develop `13cc36d4acbe0f29f426cd9e6e69aeb262abe818`. Normal `bun install` passed without skipping native setup. Final `bun run verify` passed all 373 tasks and repository audits. The final isolated deterministic run passed all 42 scenarios with zero failures or skips. Bun's post-summary directory-mismatch diagnostic is retained in the successful log.

The previous candidate `126a4e464d289fb3e38fc09af72b0d72283bc02f` passed all 373 repository tasks/audits and all 42 simulated scenarios. All 97 PR-owned file blobs are identical after the final rebase; only the separately merged Google/Discord files changed. [Final source continuity](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/pr-evidence-13/31493-final-source-continuity.json) distinguishes this evidence from final-head checks.

Unchanged affected source also passed OpenAI 611 tests/43 files, Workerd 7 integration tests with one explicitly gated live-search skip, default SQL 235 tests with three Electric skips, and focused real SQL storage checks 112 tests with one PostgreSQL-only skip. Initial stale-core document-sharing failures and the successful canonical rebuild/retest are retained. These are scoped suites, not a claim that every repository integration ran.

The app audit passed 230 tests with 224 captures: zero needs-work/broken findings, 212 OCR verifications and 12 documented semantic exemptions. All 56 desktop and 56 portrait-mobile views plus all 23 flagged captures were inspected. Twelve Family interview hover timeouts targeted intentionally disabled buttons; these are inapplicable interaction checks, not successful hover proof.

The complete Storybook gate rendered all 1,690 stories with zero accessibility violations, broken renders or JavaScript page exceptions. Raw logs retain 64 stories with resource console errors and 69 with network failures, classified as absent static-server APIs, unavailable example media and browser-aborted PDFs. This is not a console-clean or live-integration claim.

Matched original-build and repaired-build captures cover 70 states at 1440px desktop and 390px mobile. All current rest and available hover captures were inspected. Explicit controls checks prove desktop orange-to-darker-orange hover, mobile card dismissal and reload persistence, message-action reveal, and the portal close control. Touch devices correctly retain resting colors. An additional actual 320px-wide billing capture preserves all digits and wraps the full resource identifier. Internal scroll regions only establish the captured viewport; the tall 320px capture includes the complete billing card.

topPRs.title: perf(ci): consolidate develop validation and remove repeated work
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
# Relates to

Closes #31540. Consolidates deterministic develop validation from 98 expanded jobs to 57 and removes seven redundant workflow wrappers (67 to 60 files). Required contracts retain explicit owners; actual runtime savings remain under measurement.

# Sync with develop

Rebased onto `e2678ac60c`. Pinned Bun 1.3.14 / Node 24.15.0 install passed. Full root verify passed both before rebase and on this exact post-rebase head (exit 0).

# Risks

Medium: changes validation orchestration, dependency setup, shards and aggregate admission across the repository. The standalone secretless gateway, platform, database, release and deployment authority boundaries remain distinct. Aggregates reject failed, cancelled, skipped or missing mandatory results. Production effects are not dispatched by this validation exercise.

# Background

Canonical CI now owns server/client/plugin/script suites, root quality, the complete six-shard app inventory and unique migrated scenario/runtime contracts. UI fixtures share one owner. Story Gate uses four shards with the same complete catalog. Duplicate personal-assistant/agent integrations remain in the general E2E runner. Cloud source checks delegate to mandatory canonical verify only when called by Develop Full; standalone cloud validation retains them.

Develop Full removes 28 ineffective evidence-cache operations under its existing current-run-only policy. Exact-source evidence and successful completion remain prerequisites for the effect handoff. JS setup omits unneeded native/Python/protoc installation; existing native/manual consumers explicitly preserve prerequisites. Dependency caches restore only exact lock keys. Failure results are uploaded without inventing a successful manifest.

Type: CI performance and correctness improvements. No rendered UI, runtime prompts, product model behavior, credentials or production configuration changes.

# Documentation changes needed?

Updated workflow ownership README and WORKFLOW_SIMPLIFICATION_PLAN.md with every workflow disposition, coverage mapping, baseline, implementation decisions and outstanding acceptance measurements.

# Testing

Start with the plan and `.github/workflows/develop-full.yml`, then canonical CI and the setup composite.

- 153 focused workflow/script tests passed before the admission-only follow-up; that follow-up passed 16 parsed-condition cases and 7 dedicated-canary workflow tests. Exact admission-fixed head full verify passed; actionlint, 157 guide pairs and relative Markdown links pass. Real live-admission shell self-test passes; direct screenshot diagnostic 2 tests pass.
- App partition enumeration: 962 project/test identities, complete union across six shards, zero overlaps/missing entries. This proves selection; hosted app shards separately passed on the earlier checkpoint.
- Earlier full root `bun run verify`: exit 0. Final post-rebase root: exit 0.
- Earlier [canonical run](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/actions/runs/35159462165) passed all six app shards, Android AAB, Windows security, desktop, frontend build, remote capabilities, accounts, walkthrough and real-local browser contracts. Other failures listed below prevent a full-green claim.
- [Four-shard Story Gate](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/actions/runs/35159762211) passed and its aggregate was read: 1,689 stories, zero broken/accessibility failures. 78 stories record console errors; this is not console-clean evidence or a full develop result.
- [Cloud run](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/actions/runs/35159764700) passed database integration, e2e and stack-e2e; unit and former gateway migration failures are recorded below.

# Evidence Gate

<!-- evidence-head:feb72b6ea3f674f37f281281090e1bacf28db47d -->

<!-- evidence-row:before-screenshots -->
- [x] N/A - CI orchestration only; no rendered UI changes.

<!-- evidence-row:after-screenshots -->
- [x] N/A - CI orchestration only; no rendered UI changes.

<!-- evidence-row:walkthrough-video -->
- [x] N/A - no changed interactive product flow.

<!-- evidence-row:backend-logs -->
- [x] N/A - no product backend behavior changes; actual workflow logs linked above.

<!-- evidence-row:frontend-logs -->
- [x] N/A - no changed frontend request or state path.

<!-- evidence-row:llm-trajectory -->
- [x] N/A - no model, provider, prompt or action behavior changes.

<!-- evidence-row:domain-artifacts -->
- [x] N/A - no product domain state changes; workflow result artifacts and story report inspected from linked runs.

<!-- evidence-row:ocr-review -->
- [x] N/A - no rendered visual source changes.

# Evidence Details

Workflow logs and generated reports are linked above. Local executable regression runs exercise failed/missing child-result admission, current-source evidence handling, real shell credential admission, shard completeness and planted formatting failures. UI screenshots/video, live LLM trajectories, audio and installed-device captures are N/A because this change only reorganizes their existing automation; it does not change those product surfaces.

## Known gaps / failures

Earlier checkpoints exposed two workflow regressions: operational YAML formatting affected a migration-boundary test, and removing the gateway wrapper violated a source-only authority test. Both are corrected with original formatting/boundary restored, and focused tests pass. App-core diagnostics were accidentally invoking the full chained package suite; the direct owning runner now executes the intended two tests. Device README wording was restored and checked.

Remaining old-checkpoint failures have concurrent owners: browser incomplete-read assertion (#31544); goals source-leaf resolution and OpenAI fixture (#31470/#31493 repair lane); scenario/When2Speak fixtures (#31493); LIFE integration isolation (#31032); Workerd expected tool catalog (embedding repair plus #31537 prerequisites). No tests are suppressed for these failures. Current-develop hosted validation, cold/warm setup comparison and three comparable full-run timing samples remain outstanding. Seven-day baseline has no successful control; 98→57 is a structural reduction, not measured billed-minute savings.

## CI availability record

- PR head: feb72b6ea3f674f37f281281090e1bacf28db47d; validated base: `e2678ac60c`.
- Run URLs and failures: above; older hosted checkpoints do not certify this exact head.
- Exact-head focused commands exit 0; final post-rebase root gate exit 0.
- Merge revision and method: not merged.
- Remaining validation: exact-head hosted admission, develop full completion and performance measurement.

## Admission correction review

Moved remote-capability cloud/provider/validator jobs reject cleanup-only and diagnostic dispatches; generic smoke excludes the remote-capabilities suite. Sixteen executable cases evaluate the actual parsed conditions for permitted versus exclusive recovery modes. Dedicated canary workflow tests (7), formatting and actionlint pass. Full root verify on a433fe964a exited zero after pinned install. No live effects were dispatched to test admission.

## Before/after command ownership

Comparison base `cfd144bf95`; implementation PR #31556. This maps automatic develop contracts, not hypothetical manual workflow invocations. Package manifests and selectors remain unchanged unless stated.

| Old owner / command family | Current owner | Preservation / intentional difference |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CI + Test server/client/plugin suites | CI tests_server, tests_client, tests_plugins | Same lane runners and package filters; existing agent/remaining partition, four plugin shards, Node PGlite retained. Duplicate wrapper sweeps removed. |
| CI + Test + Scenario full script sweep | CI tests | One complete discovered script inventory; no subset replacement. Root test-vacuity behavioral tests belong to this inventory. |
| CI quality + Test merge quality + Quality format/lint/static | CI quality | Full root verify and format; unique guide/link/alias/type-dup/focused-test/prompt-secret/Bun-pin guards retained. GitHub plugin build is in verify dependency closure (observed log). |
| Quality frontend | CI frontend-build | Same app web build and homepage test/snapshot inventory; root verify owns repeated homepage type/lint. |
| Quality comment-only conditional | No automatic develop job | Old condition required pull_request though its callers were develop push or manual dispatch. Local comment-only command remains; no actual develop coverage removed. |
| CI app smoke (926) + Test WebKit (36) + Scenario named/auto browser slices | CI smoke six shards | Exact project/file/test union 962; zero added/lost; Test WebKit opt-in moves to shared PLAYWRIGHT_WEBKIT=1. |
| Scenario auto-discovery | CI smoke | Original script selects69 filenames, Playwright selects252 actual tests; all252 retained. Four ignored filenames were already excluded by project configuration. |
| Scenario special workflow-real-local command | CI app-workflow-runtime | Exact real-local stack, workflow-journey and video flags retained separately. |
| Scenario accounts + mock walkthrough | CI app-accounts-ui + app-walkthrough-mock | Same dedicated launchers, isolated account credential directory, core/i18n build and ffmpeg prerequisites. |
| Scenario local provisioning/chat | CI scenario-unit-coverage | Same executable local provisioning/chat commands; full scenario unit suite already in server lane. |
| Test zero-key-unit coverage | CI server/client suites | Same core/scenario/UI tests included by their existing package commands. Historical missing app route metadata files are not restored. |
| Test remote capability guards, Docker, synthetic-world | CI remote-capabilities | Same command family; broken Docker now fails instead of skipping. Credential-backed producers are manual only below. |
| Test integration-tests + CI general E2E | CI smoke_lanes | Executable E2E plan and hosted log include both agent and personal-assistant integration commands; duplicate dedicated job removed, Node PGlite retained. |
| Test desktop/diagnostics/scenario/model harness | CI explicit same-named owners | Same contracts. App-core screenshot command corrected to direct owning Vitest runner, avoiding accidental full chained suite. |
| CI cloud sweep + Cloud | cloud-tests | Sole cloud unit/integration/browser/stack owner; canonical verify owns source checks only for Develop Full, standalone defaults retain them. |
| Gateway | cloud-gateway-discord | Original secretless, inputless source-only boundary retained after adversarial guard failure. |
| Test client performance + UI fixture + gesture wrappers | ui-e2e-gate | Performance and core/extended/gesture contracts retain their browser/environment differences. |
| Story Gate eight shards | Story Gate four shards | Same1689-story catalog; strict aggregate, one build, four outputs. Hosted result passed. |
| CI/Test branch secrets + gitleaks | gitleaks | One branch scan; PR diff scan remains independent. |
| CI Android + Windows security | CI Android + reusable Windows owner | Unconditional required branches, same actual AAB/Windows contracts; hosted checkpoint passed. |
| Test live cloud/provider/artifact validator | live-smoke remote-capabilities | Explicit manual suite; cleanup-only and diagnostics deny all three jobs, generic smoke excludes this suite. No secrets silently skip requested work. |
| Develop cached evidence | Develop current-run manifests | Removed28 cache operations that could never authorize reuse. Exact source/input/run result and effects admission retained. |

### Browser selection reproduction and environment

Pinned Node24.15.0/Bun1.3.14. Original canonical: `CI=true TEST_LANE=pr ELIZA_LIVE_TEST=0 SCENARIO_USE_DETERMINISTIC_MODEL=1 bun run --cwd packages/app test:e2e --list --reporter=json` without PLAYWRIGHT_WEBKIT. Original Test WebKit: same plus `PLAYWRIGHT_WEBKIT=1 --project=webkit`. Original Scenario auto: original cfd script and workflow produce `--list-auto`69 selectors; pass those filenames to the same app command with `--project=chromium --list --reporter=json`. New selection enables PLAYWRIGHT_WEBKIT=1 and partitions the unchanged full suite with ELIZA_UI_SMOKE_SHARD=1/6 through6/6.

Playwright config, runner, package manifest, and spec sources have no diff against cfd. Only deny-list prose changes; list membership is unchanged. Old Scenario keyless environment is explicitly retained in CI smoke, including empty provider keys. The old canonical runtime-selected environment was already keyless by default; explicit flags make the merged owner deterministic. Dedicated accounts/mock/real-local paths retain their distinct environments; no real-local proof is inferred from the stub/default inventory.

Result: old canonical926 + old WebKit36 = new962. Old auto252 is a subset; lost0, added0. Four selectors with no Chromium tests already ignored: applications-dropdown-contrast, audit-project-worker-contract, cloud-surfaces-aesthetic-audit, viewport-zoom-visualviewport (the last remains in mobile Chromium). Selection evidence does not certify execution, live-provider availability, or absence of runtime skips.

Evidence JSON SHA256: `8c728e48d92e897f859a95845c05dd91af91cda39f02457fbc96c662240af8ad`. Full tuple inventories retained locally in `/tmp/workflow-old-new-browser-proof.json`; summary independently recomputed during review.

### Nested personal-assistant duplicate

Both hosted client and plugin shard3 ran the same2,750-test command (2,744executed,6skips,0failures); client duplicate took17.88minutes. Pinned Vitest `list --config vitest.config.ts --filesOnly --json=<file>` with the respective PR lane flags selects exactly309files in either case. Plugin adds VITEST_UNIT_ONLY=1; neither plugin source/config nor its base Vitest config consumes it. CI runtime/version/memory/keyless flags match; plugin shard uses additional native prerequisites for other packages without replacing this suite. Executable root plans prove the client filter removes only the personal-assistant task and preserves app, browser extension and UI; plugin matrix remains its owner, and E2E integration stays separate. Raw proof: `/tmp/workflow-pa-ownership-proof.json`.

## Final frozen-head qualification

Head `feb72b6ea3f674f37f281281090e1bacf28db47d`, base `e2678ac60cccb96216dc227010473f84324ee908`. Pinned install exit0; full `bun run verify` exit0 after rebase. Focused final qualification: 87 admission/evidence/permission/workflow tests, 16 executable live condition cases, 19 aggregate/pinning checks; actionlint and Markdown validation pass. The one-worker root gate was paused for shared-host overload, then resumed and completed without discarded work.

Failed browser shards retain Playwright reports and test-results for three days under unique shard names; successful shards avoid these uploads. The only client task removed is the proven duplicate personal-assistant suite, which remains exactly once in plugin shard3.

Previous public head a433 passed all four hosted PR checks in [run35163770832](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/actions/runs/35163770832). Those results support the reviewed changes but are not an exact-head hosted-green claim for this final rebased head; its checks are starting afresh. Merge and exact-develop acceptance remain pending.

## Published reviewed evidence

- [Complete artifact manifest](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/pr-evidence-13/31556-feb72b6ea3-manifest-v2.json)
- [Before/after command and environment ownership](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/pr-evidence-13/31556-feb72b6ea3-ownership.md)
- [Complete old/new browser identities](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/pr-evidence-13/31556-feb72b6ea3-browser-selection.json)
- [Personal-assistant selection and retained owner proof](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/pr-evidence-13/31556-feb72b6ea3-personal-assistant-selection.json)
- [Local final-head qualification receipt](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/pr-evidence-13/31556-feb72b6ea3-qualification.json)

Browser artifact SHA256: `8c728e48d92e897f859a95845c05dd91af91cda39f02457fbc96c662240af8ad`. The manifest binds the remaining artifact hashes to final head and base. These are reviewed selection/local-qualification artifacts, not a full-develop success certificate.

### Raw qualification logs

- [Final full verify log](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/pr-evidence-13/31556-feb72b6ea3-verify.log), SHA256 `bd4f6b91396e364097978fe769990aea840955e69341fbd4da797410dca6b3b1`.

- [Final-head focused and live-admission log](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/releases/download/pr-evidence-13/31556-feb72b6ea3-focused.log).

Manifest v2 binds all seven artifacts; every uploaded artifact was downloaded again and its hash verified. Verification passed with existing non-fatal lint/i18n diagnostics visible in the raw log; no warning-free claim is made. No source changed while adding evidence.
